<Route path="/ade/dashboard/versions" />

**Versions** is one project's history: every version, its status, its mock, and what changed. Open
it by **clicking a project** on [Projects](./projects.mdx). To move to another project, **click the
project's name** at the end of the breadcrumb: type in **Jump to project** to filter, then **click a
project**. **All projects** at the bottom goes back to Projects. Catalog items are not listed;
convert one to OpenAPI first.

The header holds **“Compare”** (needs two versions), **“Import”**, **More actions** (`⋯`) and
**“New version”**. **More actions** holds:

| Item | Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Merge branches…** | Opens the merge dialog. Marked `gitlike`; unavailable until the project has two named branches, and the row says why |
| **Sunset timeline** | Opens the [sunset timeline](/ship) |
| **Published surface** | Opens the published surface |
| **Export studio** | Opens the Export studio, once it is released |
| **Copy link to project** | Copies a link to this project's Versions page (**`⌘ ⇧ C`**) |

The dialogs are on [Version dialogs](./version-dialogs.mdx). Keyboard paths are on
[Keyboard](../workspace/keyboard.md).

## Timeline

<Screenshot id="versions" alt="The Versions page, Timeline tab: the project name as the last breadcrumb, Compare, Import, More actions and New version, the Status strip, the Project facts card, and the version list under its one filter toolbar" caption="Captured from a development build, which also draws git-like controls marked gitlike; production builds hide them." />

From top to bottom:

1. **Status** — one row of chips, one per thing worth knowing: whether the latest change is
   **Compatible** (or has **Breaking changes**), **What’s new** in the draft, and any version that
   is **deprecated**. **Click a chip** to open its detail underneath; only one detail is open at a
   time, and the most urgent one opens on its own. Each detail keeps its actions: **“View
   report”**, **“Open changes”**, **“Sunset timeline”** and **“Migration guide”**. **Click the
   open chip** (or **“Collapse”**, or press <kbd>Esc</kbd>) to hide the detail; the page remembers
   your choice for this project until you close the tab. With nothing to report, the row is not
   drawn.
2. **Project** — id, slug, head version, last publish, and a link to **Published surface**.
3. **The list** — one toolbar on top of the table, then the versions. See [Filter the
   list](#filter-the-list). The columns are **Version**, **Revision / changelog**, **Status**,
   **Mock**, **Created by**, **Created** and actions. Badges mark the **HEAD** version,
   **Published** (read-only) and **Locked** versions.

### Filter the list

Every filter sits in the toolbar on top of the table, left to right:

| Control | Does |
| --- | --- |
| **Search revisions** | Matches the message, changelog, commit body and commit author as you type |
| **All lifecycles** | Shows only **Stable**, **Beta**, **Deprecated** or **Archived** versions |
| **“Any time”** | Opens **Created between**: set **From** and **To**, or **click** **Last 7 days**, **Last 30 days** or **This quarter**, then **click “Apply”**. **“Clear”** removes the range. The button then shows the range, for example **Last 7 days** |
| **“All authors”** | Opens a list of the people who created the versions shown. **Click a name** to see only theirs |
| **All revisions** | Shows the versions reachable from one tag. Shown when the project has tags |
| **All** · **Drafts** · **Published** | Narrows the list by state; each chip shows its count |
| **“Clear filters (n)”** | Appears while any filter is on; **n** is how many. **Click** it to show every version again |
| **Sorted by …** | Sorts by created date, version or another column |

<kbd>Esc</kbd> closes the date box and the author list without changing the filter. The filters are kept in
the page address, so you can **copy the link** to share a filtered list. Switching to another project
clears the search, author, dates, tag and lifecycle; the state chip stays.

### The mock switch

Each row's **Mock** switch serves that version from Apiome's hosted mock. A published version's
mock reads **Mock on** or **Mock off**; a draft's mock is private and needs an API key (**Draft
mock off** until you turn it on). When it is on, the cell shows the mock URL with a copy button,
the **Scenarios** and **Correlation** editors and 30 days of usage. See [One mock
engine](../reference/mock-runtime/one-mock-engine.md).

### Row actions

The row's quick buttons are **Publish** (or **Unpublish**) and **Edit** or **Schedule sunset
(EOL)**. Its **Actions** menu holds:

| Item | Does |
| --- | --- |
| **View spec** | Opens the generated OpenAPI document (JSON or YAML) to copy or download |
| **Export to another format…** | Opens the export dialog — see [Export](./version-dialogs.mdx#export) |
| **Schedule sunset (EOL)…** | Deprecates the version and sets its end-of-life date |
| **Edit** | Changes lifecycle, notes and sunset metadata |
| **Publish** / **Unpublish** | Publishes the version, or takes it back after a confirmation. Unpublishing moves the version's tags back to the previous published version and notifies webhook subscribers — see [Unpublish a version](../ship/publish-a-version.md#unpublish-a-version) |

Git-like actions (branch, fork, tag, freeze, lock, delete) also live here when <Flag
name="FEATURE_GITLIKE"/> is on — it is off in every shipped build. See [Git-like
features](./version-dialogs.mdx#git-like-features). With the flag on, a **Server ahead** chip joins
the status row — on every tab — when someone pushed after you; its detail offers **“Pull”** and
**“Open merge”**.

## Changes

The **Changes** tab lists each published version's classified changelog — breaking, non-breaking
and docs-only changes — which Apiome writes right after a publish.

<Screenshot id="versions-changes" alt="The Changes tab: published versions on the left, the selected version's classified changelog on the right" />

## Test bench

The **Test bench** tab checks a payload against any schema in the project: pick a schema, paste or
generate a payload, and **click “Validate”**. Findings point at the line that failed; saved
payloads become a test suite. It needs a project with a slug.

<Screenshot id="versions-test-bench" alt="The Test bench tab: a schema picker, a payload editor with one finding, generated payloads and saved test payloads" />

## Discussion

The **Discussion** tab collects comment threads on the project's classes, properties, paths and
operations — **Open**, **Resolved**, **Orphaned** or **All**, filtered by kind of element. Its count
is the number of unresolved threads.

<Screenshot id="versions-discussion" alt="The Discussion tab: open comment threads on classes, properties and operations" />

## Repository

The **Repository** tab binds a draft version to a branch of a registered repository. Pick the
**Version**, then under **Bind this draft** choose the **Repository**, a **Branch** and a **Source
path**, and **click “Bind”**. Register repositories first under **Bring in → Repositories**.

<Screenshot id="versions-repository" alt="The Repository tab: an unbound draft, with repository, branch and source path fields" />

## Conversion

When the project was created by [converting a catalog item](../bring-in/convert-to-openapi.md), a
**Conversion** tab shows its conversion history — every projection and the evidence behind it. Other
projects do not have this tab.

## Change report <Flag name="FEATURE_GITLIKE"/>

A **Change report** tab with the publication change report and its templates appears only when
`FEATURE_GITLIKE` is on and `NEXT_PUBLIC_CHANGE_REPORT_UI` is not `0`. `FEATURE_GITLIKE` is a
constant in `apiome-ui/lib/feature-flags.ts` and is `false`, so shipped builds do not show it.

## With the CLI or the API

- CLI: `apiome versions list|get|publish|unpublish|fork`, `apiome mock status|enable|disable` — see
  the [`versions` command reference](../reference/cli/versions.md) and the [CLI
  quick-start](../reference/cli-quickstart.md). To take a release back with a recorded reason, see
  [Unpublish a version](../ship/publish-a-version.md#unpublish-a-version).
- REST: `GET` / `POST /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}`, `PUT /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}/{version}`,
  `…/publish`, `…/unpublish`, `PUT …/mock`, `POST /v1/versions/{tenant}/{project}/fork`,
  `GET /v1/versions/{tenant}/sunset-timeline` — see the [API reference](../reference/api-reference.md).

### Fork a version into another project from the CLI

A **fork** copies one version of a project into **another** project as a new draft version, and
records where it came from so it can be merged back later. (To start a new version inside the same
project, branch it instead.) The CLI can fork whether or not the Git-like features are switched on
in the web app.

1. **Preview** what would be copied:
   `apiome versions fork payments-api v2.1.0 --into payments-sandbox --to 3.0.0 --dry-run`.
   The source can be a version label (`2.1.0` or `v2.1.0`), a revision id, or a version tag.
2. **Fork** it by running the same command without `--dry-run`. Add `--notes '…'` for a short note,
   `--notes-file CHANGELOG.md` for release notes, and `--include-tags` to recreate the tags that
   point at the source version.
3. The fork copies the version's **classes and their properties**. **Paths are not copied** — the
   summary says how many the source has.

`--to` must be a plain release version (`3.0.0`, not `3.0.0-rc.1`) and greater than the source's
— pass `--allow-lesser` to go lower. If the target project already has that version, nothing is
forked and the command exits `6`. With `--json` it prints the new version.
